title: K-Pop Demon Hunters Baby Saja Figurine - New
descriptionText: The Baby Saja figurine is a collectible action figure from the K-Pop Demon Hunters set, featuring the popular character Baby Saja. This figurine captures the essence of the character from the TV show and allows fans to bring a piece of the K-Pop Demon Hunters franchise into their collection. With intricate details and high-quality design, this action figure is a must-have for fans of the show and collectors of K-Pop Demon Hunters memorabilia.
